verdict.rationale: Using a tablet as a secondary display is a fair window-management question for a desktop OS, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence that Ubuntu Desktop can extend the desktop onto a paired tablet. Remote desktop sharing ('Share your desktop remotely') is an adjacent feature, not a secondary-display capability. The multi-monitor comment concerns physical monitors and window placement, not tablets.

support.subject: As a designer, I can use a paired tablet device as a secondary display for creative apps
